key_idea: Count every circle, big and small, including the ones inside other circles.
steps: The big yellow circle has 2 small circles inside it, an orange one and a green one: 1 + 2 = 3.
Around it are the blue circle, the green circle, the big orange circle and the purple circle: 4 more.

choice_feedback.A: You may have missed one of the small circles inside the big yellow circle.
choice_feedback.C: You may have counted one circle twice.
choice_feedback.D: You may have counted some circles twice.
choice_feedback.E: There are not that many circles. Count each one once.
